---
title: Panzerotti
id: MAR-0055
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 45
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 150 g flour
- 30 g butter
- 2 egg
- 100 g Gruyère cheese
- 100 g prosciutto crudo
- 20 g Pecorino Romano
- to taste frying oil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Put the Gruyère cheese cut into small cubes, the prosciutto cut into pieces, the Pecorino Romano, and one egg in a bowl.
2. Mix well to combine the ingredients.
3. Arrange the flour in a fountain on the work surface, add the egg, the butter cut into pieces, and a pinch of salt in the center.
4. Knead energetically, adding the necessary water to obtain a smooth and firm dough.
5. Roll out a not-too-thin sheet and cut out disks of 8 cm in diameter.
6. Fill them with a spoonful of filling.
7. Fold the disks of pastry into a half-moon shape, pressing the edge well with your fingertips.
8. Fry the panzerotti in hot frying oil, drain them with the appropriate spatula, and place them on kitchen paper towels.
9. Serve them still hot.
